candidate.title: RIP-Seq
candidate.scope: The middle RIP-Seq row of the supplied RNA-Protein Interactions crop: antibody capture, depicted RNase digestion, RNA extraction, and reverse transcription to cDNA. One linear route with no retained branches. The left RNA immunoprecipitation (RIP) icon identifies the capture component. The upper Ribo-Seq/GTI-Seq/ARTseq row and lower CLIP/HITS-CLIP row are neighboring assays, not target alternatives named by this assigned RIP-Seq card. The partial uridine graphic at the right is outside this row. The inspected collection page heading and schematic caption match RIP-Seq and corroborate this route. This is the Illumina schematic implementation within the RIP-seq family. Zhao native RIP-seq supports the shared capture-to-cDNA purpose, but not the RNase-trimmed material history. The drawing ends at cDNA; additional library construction and sequencing are interpretive context, not added graph operations.
